meta.name: game-narrative-director
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about story structure, branching narrative, dialogue systems, world-building, character design, environmental storytelling, ludonarrative coherence, writing for games, lore, theme, or character arcs. Triggers on: "story", "narrative", "dialogue", "lore", "world-building", "character arc", "branching", "ludonarrative". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or game mechanics (use game-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计游戏故事、角色与世界观
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在创作游戏剧情或互动故事。
copy.tagline_en: Design game stories, characters, and worlds.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you craft game stories or interactive narratives.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成游戏叙事总监，帮你设计故事结构、分支剧情、对话系统、世界观、角色弧光等，确保游戏叙事与玩法一致。
howto.when: 当你提到“故事”、“叙事”、“对话”、“世界观”、“角色弧”等关键词，或询问游戏剧情设计时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个分支剧情，主角有两个选择，后果不同。
say.note: Claude 会规划分支节点和后续影响。

say.text: 写一段角色对话，体现他表面平静但内心愤怒。
say.note: Claude 会运用潜台词技巧。

say.text: 如何通过环境讲述一个废弃村庄的故事？
say.note: Claude 会给出环境叙事的具体方法。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a narrative director for games, helping with story structure, branching narratives, dialogue systems, world-building, character arcs, and ensuring ludonarrative coherence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "story", "narrative", "dialogue", "lore", "world-building", "character arc", or ask about game narrative design.

say_en.text: Design a branching story where the protagonist has two choices with different outcomes.
say_en.note: Claude will map out branch nodes and consequences.

say_en.text: Write a dialogue where a character seems calm but is actually angry.
How to tell a story through the environment of an abandoned village?
say_en.note: Claude will provide environmental storytelling methods.
